ex.en: The restaurant is famous for its grilled fish, a local specialty of the region.
ex.zh: 这家餐厅以烤鱼闻名，那是当地的特色菜。

words.note: 美式常用 specialty 指特色菜和专长，英式多用 speciality。

ex.en: Prices of fresh vegetables vary greatly from season to season in this market.
ex.zh: 这个市场上新鲜蔬菜的价格随季节变化很大。

words.note: 常与 from...to... 或 in 搭配；名词为 variety。

ex.en: Information about the course is readily available on the university website.
ex.zh: 关于这门课程的信息在大学网站上很容易查到。

words.note: readily 兼有「容易地」与「乐意地」两义；readily available 高频。

ex.en: She gave a coherent account of what had happened that night.
ex.zh: 她对那天晚上发生的事情做了条理清楚的叙述。

words.note: co- 表共同，her 表粘；coherent 强调逻辑连贯、不散乱。

ex.en: The two countries have long enjoyed peaceful commercial intercourse along the border.
ex.zh: 两国长期在边境地区保持着和平的商业往来。

words.note: 现多用于 social／commercial intercourse，指正式的往来交流。

ex.en: Please reply to this email at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 请在您方便时尽早回复这封邮件。

words.note: at your convenience 是礼貌说法；不说 I am convenient。

ex.en: He had the decency to apologize for the mistake he had made.
ex.zh: 他还懂得体面，为自己犯的错误道了歉。

words.note: 来自 decent（得体的）；have the decency to do 指讲体面地做。

ex.en: The witness was accused of spreading falsehoods about the company.
ex.zh: 这名证人被指控散布有关该公司的谎言。

words.note: false 加后缀 -hood 构成，指谎言或虚假，比 lie 正式。

ex.en: Learning a language requires discipline and a little patience every day.
ex.zh: 学一门语言需要自律，还需要每天一点耐心。

words.note: 作名词指纪律、学科，作动词指训练或惩戒。

ex.en: She sat by the window and pondered over the offer for a long time.
ex.zh: 她坐在窗边，长时间思索着那个提议。

words.note: 比 think 正式，多与 over／on 搭配，指仔细思量。

ex.en: A good journalist tries to give an objective view of the events.
ex.zh: 优秀的记者会努力对事件给出客观的看法。

words.note: 作形容词是客观的，作名词是目标；反义词 subjective。

ex.en: Parents can exert a strong influence on how their children study.
ex.zh: 父母能对孩子的学习方式产生很大影响。

words.note: exert 多与 influence、pressure、effort 搭配。

ex.en: The scandal forced the minister to resign from his post last week.
ex.zh: 这桩丑闻迫使那位部长上周辞去了职务。

words.note: 指丑闻，形容词 scandalous 意为令人愤慨的。

ex.en: The wing is made of a light composite material that resists heat.
ex.zh: 机翼由一种耐热的轻质复合材料制成。

words.note: com- 表共同，pos 表放；指由多个部分合成的。

ex.en: Heavy rain hindered the rescue team from reaching the village.
ex.zh: 大雨妨碍了救援队抵达那个村庄。

words.note: hinder sb from doing 为固定结构，语气比 prevent 弱。

ex.en: The scent of fresh coffee filled the small kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜咖啡的香气充满了这间小厨房。

words.note: 指淡淡香味或气味，也可指踪迹；follow the scent 追踪。

ex.en: Experts estimate that the project will take about two more years.
ex.zh: 专家估计这个项目还需要大约两年时间。

words.note: 作动词重音在后，作名词重音在前；rough estimate 为粗估。

ex.en: She earned her diploma in nursing after three years of study.
ex.zh: 她学习三年后获得了护理专业文凭。

words.note: 指毕业文凭；degree 指学位，二者不可混用。

ex.en: Several of her paintings will be on exhibit at the museum this spring.
ex.zh: 她的几幅画今年春天将在博物馆展出。

words.note: 作名词指展品；on exhibit 相当于 on display。

ex.en: The company spent millions building a brand that customers trust.
ex.zh: 该公司花费数百万打造了一个受顾客信任的品牌。

words.note: 作动词指打烙印、加污名；brand name 是品牌名。

ex.en: The suspension of the talks surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 会谈的中止让房间里的所有人都感到意外。

words.note: suspend 是动词；suspension bridge 指悬索桥。

ex.en: The doctor advised him to avoid alcohol while taking the medicine.
ex.zh: 医生建议他服药期间不要饮酒。

words.note: 不可数名词；alcoholic 指含酒精的或酗酒者。

ex.en: Some delay was inevitable once the snow began to fall.
ex.zh: 雪一开始下，某种延误就不可避免了。

words.note: in-（不）+ evit（避开）+ able，常与 delay、decline 搭配。

ex.en: The manager continues to deny taking money from the company account.
ex.zh: 经理仍否认从公司账户里拿过钱。

words.note: 后接 doing 而非 to do；deny sb sth 意为拒绝给予。

ex.en: Workers dug a deep trench along the road to lay new pipes.
ex.zh: 工人们沿路挖了一条深沟以铺设新管道。

words.note: 指沟渠，也指战壕；trench coat 即风衣。

phr.zh: 从 B 中减去 A

ex.en: If you subtract three from ten, you get seven.
ex.zh: 十减去三等于七。

words.note: subtract A from B 表示从 B 减去 A，介词用 from。

ex.en: The park offers plenty of space for outdoor recreation.
ex.zh: 这个公园为户外娱乐提供了充足的空间。

words.note: re-（再）+ create，由「恢复精力」引申为消遣娱乐。

ex.en: He threw the broken phone away in frustration.
ex.zh: 他沮丧地把坏掉的手机扔到一边。

words.note: 不可数，常用 in frustration；动词 frustrate 使受挫。

ex.en: Her parents send a small monthly allowance to help with rent.
ex.zh: 她父母每月寄一笔小额零用钱帮她付房租。

words.note: make allowance for 意为考虑到、体谅，为常考短语。

ex.en: The hurricane destroyed hundreds of houses along the coast.
ex.zh: 这场飓风摧毁了沿海数百所房屋。

words.note: 指大西洋飓风；太平洋的称 typhoon，印度洋的称 cyclone。
